title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG AND PARTY TRAVEL BY THE PACIFIC RAILROAD
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg and his companions begin their train journey across America, facing a lengthy delay when a massive herd of buffalo crosses the tracks.
summary_detail: The travelers depart Oakland on the Pacific Railroad, crossing California and entering Nevada. The journey provides stunning views of the Sierra Nevada mountains and comfortable sleeping arrangements in a converted car. However, their progress is interrupted in Nevada by a massive herd of buffalo blocking the tracks for three hours, much to Passepartout's frustration, before they continue into Utah.
